description: This file defines the class 'LiquidTagHelperActivator' which manages the creation and property setting of 'TagHelper' instances in an ASP.NET Core project, specifically for Liquid templating integration within OrchardCore. It includes methods for constructing tag helpers, setting properties via reflection, and handling dependency injection.
